anomalies.observed: On the POWER TRAIN page the 'Reverse polarity protection / Transient voltage stabilizer' block is built around T3 = AON6407, an N-channel MOSFET, wired as a SHUNT across the +24 V rail: drain at +24 V, source at GND, and gate tied to the junction of R7 (33 k to +24 V) and D3 (12 V zener to GND), i.e. the gate is held at ~12 V while the source is at 0 V.
anomalies.expected: The spec's power architecture (§3) routes the input as F1 -> D2 (TVS) -> /+24V_FB -> +24 V bulk with no MOSFET in the input path, and §2 assigns the AON6407 (T3) to the ATO-valve low-side switch, not to input protection. A series high-side reverse-polarity device must be a P-channel MOSFET (r1 used SI2301). An N-MOSFET with Vgs ~ +12 V and source at GND is fully enhanced and creates a hard short from +24 V to GND.

evidence.quote: POWER TRAIN: 'F1 7A' -> '+24Vr' node -> T3 AON6407 (gate left, top terminal to +24V line that also feeds C6/U1 VIN, bottom terminal to GND); R7 33k from +24V to gate, D3 12V from gate to GND.
§3: '24V external supply ... -> F1 (fuse) -> D2 (TVS clamp) -> /+24V_FB -> +24V bulk rail' (no MOSFET); §2: 'T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch'.

anomalies.impact: The N-MOSFET is permanently on, shorting the 24 V input to ground; F1 (7 A) blows / the supply current-limits and the board never powers up.

anomalies.observed: On the WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES page the TF-Luna module PR1 (VCC/SDA/SCL/GND) is wired through header H1 to +5V, I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL (global labels), i.e. the LiDAR is connected to the main I2C bus and powered.
anomalies.expected: The spec states PR1 is not implemented in the r2 wiring: 'its pins are typed free ... it is not connected to any net' and 'on_board: no'; the actually-wired water-level sensor is the HC-SR04-style ultrasonic on two GPIOs (which is absent from this drawing).
